about_the_game:
Avaroth Online is a multiplayer online RPG set in a unique world inspired by the landscapes and culture of Argentina. With a hardcore focus, the game features dynamic PvP combat, character progression, crafting, building, and open-world exploration where survival is never guaranteed.

From the ruins of a post-apocalyptic Buenos Aires to dangerous wild regions, each zone offers unique challenges, smart enemies, and other players willing to do whatever it takes to survive—or dominate.

Gather resources, craft your gear, join clans, claim territory, and take part in dynamic events that shape the world in real time.

Key Features:

  • Real-time MMORPG with short- and long-range combat

  • Persistent world with PvP and high-risk zones

  • Skill-based progression with levels, reputation, and specialization

  • Base building, crafting, and trading systems

  • Dedicated servers and ongoing development with community involvement

content_descriptors.notes: You can kill other users, nudity can only be seen when you have no clothing equipped but is a semi naked. You cannot have sexual interactions.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 13600 / AMD ryzen 5 7500F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
